findings.issue: Prior HOLD resolved by positive primary comparator. The publisher explicitly groups ball, needle roller and cylindrical roller under radial (016-05), ball and tapered roller under angular (016-08), and ball and needle roller under thrust (016-07). This establishes the exact tapered-to-cylindrical correction within the teaching taxonomy, without requiring a specific textbook edition. TSK independently corroborates angular ball/tapered grouping. The explanation correctly distinguishes this teaching convention from broader manufacturer classification and real transmission use; it does not deny tapered bearings radial load capacity.
